articles.headline: Parsons expresses relief, excitement for fresh start with Packers
articles.description: Micah Parsons was introduced by the Packers on Friday and said he was relieved and excited to get back to playing football after a contentious offseason in Dallas.

images.name: Micah Parsons [600x400]
images.caption: Micah Parsons said he doesn't expect his back to be an issue and plans to play in the Packers' Sept. 7 season opener against the Lions.

images.name: Micah Parsons: Trade to Packers is a 'blessing in disguise'
images.caption: Micah Parsons discusses his trade to the Packers and how he is going to prove Green Bay made the right decision.

articles.headline: Will he or won't he? Derrick Henry, Mike Evans in range of major milestones
articles.description: Potential career milestones are on the horizon for several players. We look at the odds and predict whether they'll get there in 2025.
